acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider AI website optimization for GEO if you have a physical presence, serve specific local markets, or rely on attracting nearby customers. This is particularly beneficial if you're struggling to rank in local search results, seeing competitors outrank you for geo-specific keywords, or if your current local SEO efforts are time-consuming and yielding limited results. It's also ideal for businesses looking to scale their local reach across multiple locations efficiently, such as in New York City or Los Angeles, and ensure consistent local visibility.
